newsitem.title: UK: IPE NATGAS EASES LOWER IN SEP/OCT, REST UNTRADED.
newsitem.headline: IPE NATGAS EASES LOWER IN SEP/OCT, REST UNTRADED.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures eased lower at the front end of the forward curve on Thursday, while further out months were untraded.
Fifty lots traded on September, which extended losses made on both the IPE and over-the-counter markets on Wednesday.
The contract shed 0.05 pence a therm (p/th) to trade at 9.35 pence a therm.
"It's weaker at the front but it doesn't seem to be reflected in the rest of the market," a broker said.
October traded just before the end of the morning session. Twenty five lots changed hands at 11.00 p/th, 0.10 p/th down on Wednesday's settlement.
